sourceInformation.tech: Three.js r180 (0.180.0), WebGPU, Rapier 0.19.3, Gamepad API, Web Audio API, WebRTC, AI Hub Session Protocol v1 (client 1.4.0)
sourceInformation.artDirection: Procedural cel shading, ink outlines, warm art deco city, comic typography
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer, AnimationClip and native KeyframeTracks for idle, flight, boost and cape; procedural world animation
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-synthesized heroic music at 10% default, flight and power effects, Animalese-style gibberish voices; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub shared-world co-op for 1–4, direct WebRTC co-op for 2, same-browser BroadcastChannel co-op for 1–4, couch co-op for 2
sourceInformation.testing: 212 checks passed: native WebGPU draw submissions, full scripted campaign and bridge bonus, physics, menus, balance controls, simulated standard gamepad, touch, OfflineAudioContext, file:// boot, WebRTC/BroadcastChannel and official 4-player Hub stress/server/host-leave harness. Visual art reviewed through optional WebGL compatibility backend. Real controller, separate-device NAT and audible listening: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: none; only user-specified AI Hub integration source and downloadable engine dependencies accessed

testingFeedback: 212 consolidated automated checks passed. Testing and static review caught 7 implementation issues; all were fixed. Test-script expectation fixes are not counted as game issues.

3 were startup or co-op breaking: bundled helper-name collisions, missing network actor setup, and GPU warmup exceeding the Hub ready deadline. The remaining issues were guest enemy visuals, menu input-hint switching, keyboard slider arrows, and typing not refreshing the menu idle timer.

The complete scripted campaign exercised actual powers and sunlight recharge, while the official stressed four-player Hub harness exposed integration timing. Travel was accelerated with developer teleports.

Early software-WebGPU screenshots were blank and could not assess art. Real submitted draws were checked after explicitly selecting SwiftShader ANGLE; the scene was visually reviewed with the optional WebGL compatibility renderer.
engineFeedback: Three.js TSL makes a genuine three-band cel shader straightforward, and AnimationMixer provides clean native flight and cape animation. Rapier gives solid sliding collision during free flight.

The initial single-file concatenation collided on common helper names. Waiting for an optional full shader precompile also caused Hub ready deadlines to expire; isolated module scopes and lazy GPU compilation fixed both.
The superhero flight controller, rescue and power interactions, mission state machine, TV-scale menu focus, touch assistance, procedural city, code audio, and authoritative multiplayer snapshots.
Coordinating browser GPU startup, physics authority, remote visual state and a standalone single-file package. Software-WebGPU screenshot capture in this environment remains unreliable.
A first-class asynchronous first-frame readiness and GPU diagnostic API that works reliably in automated browser tests.
promptFeedback: The source-first brief and controller-first requirements encouraged a coherent rescue game rather than a disconnected feature showcase.

The title and year alone leave the precise source edition ambiguous. I used the 1979 game’s city-rescue, green danger, bridge and telephone-booth ideas with the broader Superman tone; the intended exact edition is unknown.
Delivering a whole mission arc with enjoyable free flight, multiple co-op transports, usable touch assistance and one shareable HTML file.
Name the exact source edition and distinguish required cross-device networking from same-device co-op; specify whether a hosted signaling or TURN service is available.

aiHub.name: Son of a Sun
aiHub.tagline: A cape. A city. A brighter tomorrow.
aiHub.description: Soar over an ink-outlined metropolis, rescue a stranded news crew, cool a rooftop blaze and stop a runaway tram. Then take on Doctor Dusk and his audacious plan to privatize the sun, solo or with fellow heroes.
aiHub.controls: WASD / left stick fly; mouse / right stick look; Space / Cross rise; Ctrl / Circle descend; Shift / R2 boost; E / Square rescue, brake, punch; Q / L2 freeze; Esc / Options pause.
